daily.name: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
daily.description: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile Python, Node or Ruby apps, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same.
candidate_sources: GitHub search: topic:ai-agents created:>=2026-10-24 stars:>=30 archived:false (stars)
daily.summary_zh: 找出 Python、Node 或 Ruby 应用里真正拖慢速度的那几个函数，只把它们改写成 Rust，而不是重写整个项目。它会记录真实的函数调用，让 AI 编程助手完成改写，再用这些真实调用和额外构造的边界情况验证改写前后结果一致，最后替换进原程序；整个过程一条命令完成，也可以随时撤回。
